Name: Cuter Farmer Overalls for CP
Author: inmognito
Description:
Replaces the generic farmer overalls with a slightly cuter design.  Includes a config to enable you to switch up shirt and overall colours on the farmer's default shirt, and to switch overall colours on the two overalls with dyeable shirts.

Uses Content Patcher.

[b]How to install
[/b][list=1]
[*]Extract the zip file into the mod folder
[*]Start SMAPI to create the config file
[*]Pick your overall and shirt colours from the config menu ﻿
[*]If you're starting a new farm, you will need to exit and restart stardew before creating the farm. Otherwise it won't show you the new colours you selected on the Farmer Creation screen

[b]
[/b][/list][b]Compatibility
[/b]No known compatibility issues
[b]
Known issues
[/b][list]
[*]When you switch the shirt colour in the config, the farmer's sleeve colour won't change until you take off the farmer's shirt and put it on again.
[/list][b]
